headline: No documented interaction pathway; both agents are non-runnable, no shared channels, and no data-flow or write-conflict surfaces are exposed.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: LightZero exposes no filesystem, MCP, browser, shell, or subprocess surfaces, and RisingWave likewise shows no shared communication channel or input parser bridge. With no documented path for one agent to ingest the other's outputs, prompt injection is provably blocked in the profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP server, reassess injection risk.
IF an orchestrator begins piping one agent's raw output into the other, the pathway becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated from shared workspaces.
Do not add clipboard or MCP bridging between them.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if any output relay is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows filesystem read/write, network egress, or touched data classes, so there is no documented route for LightZero to leak data to RisingWave or vice versa. Because both are docs-only and non-runnable, the pairwise leakage pathway is absent in the current profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is granted access to a shared workspace containing sensitive files, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
IF either profile later lists data classes touched, assess whether outputs flow to the other agent.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
requires-engineering: add explicit data-class allowlists before enabling shared storage.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: LightZero cannot write the filesystem or modify git state, and RisingWave's profile exposes no write or git capability either. Without overlapping mutable-resource access, there is no capability conflict pathway between the pair.
conditions: IF either agent gains write access to the same directory, conflict risk should be reassessed.
IF git or database mutation capabilities are added to both agents, overlapping writes may emerge.
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only in the same environment.
Avoid mounting a shared writable repo.
requires-engineering: introduce locking before any shared mutable resource is enabled.

D_cascading_error.rationale: There is no evidence that RisingWave consumes LightZero outputs as authoritative input, and neither profile shows downstream action-taking authority or output parsing. With no documented handoff, cascading error is not plausible from the current pair.
conditions: IF an orchestrator starts feeding LightZero outputs directly into RisingWave workflows, reassess for verification gaps.
IF either agent is later used to trigger actions from generated text, cascading error becomes possible.
mitigations: Require human review before any cross-agent handoff.
Do not auto-execute downstream actions from model output.
requires-engineering: add validation checks if outputs become machine-consumed.

E_compliance.rationale: No data residency, certification, retention, or regulated data classes are listed for either LightZero or RisingWave, and both profiles show empty data_classes_touched. With no compliance-relevant data flow documented, there is no identifiable compliance mismatch in the pair.
conditions: IF either agent is later assigned regulated data classes, compliance must be re-evaluated.
IF residency or retention policies are added to either profile, compare them before deployment.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of this pair until policies are explicit.
requires-engineering: add residency and retention controls if regulated data is introduced.
